catalogDescription.en: Uniform-wire resistance, length, area and a prescribed linear temperature correction

teachingPurpose.zh-CN: ρL/A、材料电阻率、长度截面积和线性温度修正
teachingPurpose.en: Uniform-wire resistance, length, area and a prescribed linear temperature correction

lengthM.description: 均匀导线长度，m / uniform wire length, metres

areaMM2.description: 横截面积，mm²；不是直径 / cross-sectional area, square millimetres; not diameter

temperatureC.description: 外部给定温度，°C / prescribed temperature, Celsius

temperatureCoefficient.description: 20°C附近线性温度系数，/°C / linear temperature coefficient about 20°C, per Celsius

view.description: 形状、长度、面积、温度关系 / geometry, length, area or temperature

patchHints.zh-CN: 只修改用户要求的教学参数，其余字段保留。
patchHints.en: Patch only the requested teaching parameters and preserve the rest.

patchHints.zh-CN: 比较单变量时保留其他参数；面积是mm²，不是直径。μΩ·m与mm²均含10^-6，读数R以Ω给出。此组件用于电阻定律；电池内阻与负载功率用physics.closed-circuit，理想双电阻串并联用physics.circuit-lab。
patchHints.en: Vary one quantity while preserving others. Area is in mm² and is not diameter. Resistivity is at 20°C in μΩ·m. Use physics.closed-circuit for source resistance and physics.circuit-lab for two ideal resistors.

fallbackConditions.zh-CN: 本组件不处理：电池内阻与负载匹配、真实材料实测数据库、自发热温度求解、热膨胀、非欧姆器件、battery internal resistance、self-heating simulation。
fallbackConditions.en: Battery internal resistance or load matching, empirical material databases, self-heating, thermal expansion or non-ohmic devices.

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 电线拉长一倍和变粗一倍，电阻分别怎么变？
examplePrompts.en: How do doubling length and doubling area affect wire resistance?

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 给我看看ρL/A里面截面积和直径的区别
examplePrompts.en: Show why cross-sectional area is not the same as diameter in R=ρL/A.

supports: 给定温度的线性电阻率修正

teachingPurpose.zh-CN: E/(R+r)、路端电压、断路短路、输出功率和最大功率匹配
teachingPurpose.en: EMF, source resistance, terminal voltage, open and short states, power conservation and load matching

emf.description: 恒定电动势E，V / constant source EMF, volts; 0.01 grid

internalResistance.description: 串联内阻r，Ω / series internal resistance, ohms; 0.01 grid

loadResistance.description: 单一等效外电阻R，Ω / single equivalent ohmic load, ohms; 0.01 grid

switchClosed.description: 闭合或断开负载回路 / close or open the load circuit

view.description: 电路、U-I特性、负载功率 / circuit, source/load U-I curves or load power

showPowerBalance.description: 显示EI=I²R+I²r / show source power and both sinks

patchHints.zh-CN: 只修改用户要求的教学参数，其余字段保留。
patchHints.en: Patch only the requested teaching parameters and preserve the rest.

patchHints.zh-CN: 最大输出功率在R=r>0，但效率仅50%；高效率不等于最大功率。改变r同时影响U-I斜率和内耗；若r=0，不宣称存在有限的最大输出功率。本组件不做多支路拓扑、电表接法误差、蓄电池化学、自发热温变或RC暂态。
patchHints.en: R=r>0 maximizes load power at 50% efficiency; maximum efficiency is a different question. Open circuit has I=0 and terminal U=E. Ideal r=R=0 with E>0 has no finite steady state, and r=0 has no finite maximum power for E>0.

fallbackConditions.zh-CN: 本组件不处理：多支路拓扑自动求解、电表接法与测量误差、电池化学与容量、RC暂态、温度自发变化、arbitrary circuit topology、battery chemistry and capacity、RC transients。
fallbackConditions.en: Arbitrary multi-branch topology, meter connection errors, battery chemistry or capacity, RC transients or changing temperature.

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 电池有内阻时，电压和功率怎么分？
examplePrompts.en: How do terminal voltage and power change when a battery has internal resistance?

examplePrompts.zh-CN: 最大输出功率是不是效率也最高？给我看图
examplePrompts.en: Does maximum output power also mean maximum efficiency? Show me a plot.

supports: 恒定电动势与串联内阻
断路短路与理想短路无有限解
